stack: sqlx + SQLite, runtime queries (no compile-time query! macros, no DATABASE_URL needed). One collapsed head migration 0001_initial.sql. FromRow entity structs. From<entity> -> hermit-model DTO conversions.
notes: The head ModelSnapshot creates EXACTLY 31 tables; all 51 historical migrations are collapsed into one 0001_initial.sql at head. Historical migrations IGNORED.

All SQLite column types come from the snapshot: Guid=TEXT (uuid), DateTime=TEXT (chrono UTC RFC3339), int/long/bool/enum=INTEGER, float/double=REAL, byte[]=BLOB, PrimitiveCollection<string>=TEXT (JSON).
bool maps to INTEGER 0/1; enum-typed columns are stored as INTEGER (the C# enum's numeric value).

uint RowVersion is an IsConcurrencyToken INTEGER (optimistic-concurrency counter) on ActivityLog, Permission, Preference, User. Store as i64/u32; hermit-db owns the increment-on-save behavior (port of IHasConcurrencyToken.OnSavingChanges).

KEY FINDING: several enum-typed INTEGER columns map to EF-internal enums that are NOT ported into hermit-model (they live in Jellyfin.Database.Implementations.Enums, not the wire MediaBrowser.Model). hermit-db must DEFINE these enums itself in a db-local `enums` module (unit 2): PermissionKind, PreferenceKind, HomeSectionType, ViewType (ItemDisplayPreferences.ViewType), IndexingKind (IndexBy), ChromecastVersion, ScrollDirection/SortOrder (these two DO exist in hermit-model dto::display_preferences_dto and can be reused), and the entity-local enums BaseItemMetadataField.Id (MetadataField), BaseItemTrailerType.Id (TrailerType), LinkedChildType, ItemValueType, MediaStreamTypeEntity, ImageInfoImageType, ProgramAudioEntity. Where hermit-model already has an equivalent (MediaSegmentType, LogLevel, SyncPlayUserAccessType, SubtitlePlaybackMode, ImageType), reuse it; otherwise define locally.

hermit-model enums available for reuse in conversions: media_segments::MediaSegmentType, activity::LogLevel, users::{SyncPlayUserAccessType, SubtitleMode via configuration::SubtitlePlaybackMode}, entities::ImageType, dto::display_preferences_dto::{ScrollDirection, SortOrder}.
The BaseItems table seeds ONE placeholder row (Id 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001, Type 'PLACEHOLDER') for detached UserData — 0001_initial.sql must INSERT it.
Filtered/partial indexes exist (Permissions/Preferences UserId+Kind WHERE UserId IS NOT NULL; a BaseItems partial index on TopParentId,Type,IsVirtualItem). SQLite supports these as CREATE ... WHERE.

The C# JellyfinDbContext contains a LARGE commented-out per-type future schema (Artwork/Book/BookMetadata/Collection/Company/Episode/Genre/ItemMetadata/Library/MediaFile/Movie/MusicAlbum/Person/Rating/Release/Season/Series/Track + *Metadata tables, plus Entities/Libraries/*.cs). These DbSets are NOT active upstream and their tables are NOT in the head ModelSnapshot. DEFERRED — do not port.

ordered_units.name: unit 1 — migration + Database handle
contents: migrations/0001_initial.sql: CREATE TABLE for all 31 head tables + every index (incl. unique + filtered/partial) + the BaseItems PLACEHOLDER seed row. Column types/PKs/FKs/indexes taken verbatim from JellyfinDbModelSnapshot.cs.
src/lib.rs: crate docs + module wiring (already scaffolded).
src/error.rs: DbError (thiserror) wrapping sqlx::Error + migration errors.
src/database.rs: `Database` handle — SqlitePool builder (WAL/pragmas mirroring upstream ResetJournalMode), run_migrations() applying 0001_initial.sql, connect(path)/connect_in_memory() for tests.

src/enums.rs: db-local #[repr(i32)] enums for enum-typed INTEGER columns NOT in hermit-model: PermissionKind, PreferenceKind, HomeSectionType, ViewType, IndexingKind, ChromecastVersion, MetadataField, TrailerType, LinkedChildType, ItemValueType, MediaStreamTypeEntity, ImageInfoImageType, ProgramAudioEntity. i32<->enum helpers + reuse hermit-model enums where equivalent.
ordered_units.notes: Foundation. Everything else depends on the pool/migration and the db-local enums.
